verses.pali: “Aṭṭhime, bhikkhave, dhammā parisuddhā pariyodātā anaṅgaṇā vigatūpakkilesā anuppannā uppajjanti, nāññatra sugatavinayā.
verses.english: “Mendicants, these eight things don’t arise to be purified, bright, flawless, and rid of corruptions apart from the Holy One’s training.
They are: right view, right purpose, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, and right immersion.

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, aṭṭha dhammā parisuddhā pariyodātā anaṅgaṇā vigatūpakkilesā anuppannā uppajjanti, nāññatra sugatavinayā”ti.
verses.english: These eight things don’t arise to be purified, bright, flawless, and rid of corruptions apart from the Holy One’s training.”
